title: RASTERVARIABLES DWG writer scalar domains
scope: The DWG writer now rejects undocumented display-frame, image-quality and insertion-unit values while the parser continues to preserve source values. The existing class-version range is unchanged because ODA's DWG body specifies a bit-long field but does not define the DXF class-version constant's domain.

implementation.behavior: DRW_RasterVariables::encodeDwg accepts only frame 0/1, quality 0/1, and units 0..8 before emitting the BitShort fields. The parser is unchanged and remains tolerant.

regressionControl.coverage: The generated local DWG roundtrip writes and reads frame=1, quality=1, units=8. It separately submits frame=2, quality=2 and units=9 and requires each writer call to fail; the existing class-version overflow refusal remains checked.

validation.owningTestResult: nonzero: 16 ACDS/modeler and DWG read-outcome assertions fail; no RASTERVARIABLES assertion is reported
validation.baselineComparison: The same test exits with the same 16 unrelated ACDS/modeler and read-outcome assertions after restoring src/drw_objects.cpp and tests/dwg_local_roundtrip_tests.cpp from HEAD. The failure is pre-existing and is not attributed to this change.

fixturePolicy.generatedInputs: The local DWG writer harness generates its input; no fixture was added.

nonClaims: No physical producer with every allowed value was tested.
No native image display or unit-scaling behavior was qualified.
This does not widen the DWG-origin adapter's source graph profiles.
